summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed a Form 6-K on 3 August 2026 reporting its total voting rights and capital as at 31 July 2026 under FCA Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rule 5.6.1. The filing states issued share capital of 877,733,750 ordinary shares of US20 each, including 37,876,589 treasury shares, resulting in 839,857,161 voting shares. This is a routine regulatory notification for shareholders to determine disclosure thresholds. No transaction, special situation, or strategic event is involved. The filing simply provides the voting-rights denominator and is signed by the Company Secretary. There is no deal, premium, or structural change to analyze.
